summary: This note describes the military forces stationed in New Caledonia, namely the Armed Forces of New Caledonia (FANC), which it says number about 2,000 soldiers. It outlines the land, naval and air components, including a marine infantry regiment, several patrol and transport assets, and helicopters, and notes that 760 gendarmes are also deployed on the archipelago.
one_line: Overview of the Armed Forces of New Caledonia (FANC), their deployment locations, and their land, naval, and air assets.
key_facts: The Armed Forces of New Caledonia (French: Forces armées de Nouvelle-Calédonie), abbreviated FANC, include about 2,000 soldiers.
FANC soldiers are mainly deployed in Koumac, Nandaï, Tontouta, Plum, and Nouméa.
The land forces consist of a regiment of the Troupes de marine, the Régiment d'infanterie de marine du Pacifique.
The naval forces include two P400-class patrol vessels.
The naval forces include a BATRAL and a patrol boat of the Maritime Gendarmerie.
The air force is made up of three Casa transport aircraft.
The air force includes four Puma helicopters and a Fennec helicopter.
The air force is based in Tontouta.
In addition to the armed forces, 760 gendarmes are deployed on the archipelago.
